adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when sync is enabled it does `fetch(CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the raw `Response`, but in the fallback path it returns whatever `refreshFunction()` returns (often an Axios-like object with `.data` or a provider-specific token object). The diff shows multiple consumers expecting `.data`/provider shapes: Google Calendar now does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token` (will break if `res` is a `Response`), Zoho Bigin uses `tokenInfo.data` (will throw if `tokenInfo` is a `Response`), and Zoho CRM similarly reads `.data`. Hubspot also expects a `HubspotToken` object from the refresh call, which would be violated by returning a fetch `Response` under sync. This inconsistent return type will cause runtime errors and/or incorrect persisted token fields when sync is enabled.
